summary: This clinical study will test a medicine called zenagamtide given as an injection under the skin once a week. The study is for adults in Asia who have excess body weight like overweight or obesity. Participants will receive either zenagamtide or a placebo, which is an inactive treatment. Novo Nordisk A/S is sponsoring this Phase 3 study, which plans to include 400 participants and is currently Not yet recruiting.
